data.hypothesis: With 512 outputs per block, each cooperatively loaded source tile is reused across twice as many destination threads as with the supplied successful 256-thread tiling experiment, reducing aggregate global source loads. The larger block and 14 KiB shared-memory allocation may affect occupancy, so the net performance effect requires official measurement.
data.notes: This is a new 512-thread configuration, not an observed result. The supplied prior candidate 79f075cbacca441f passed all 11 correctness cases at a 256-particle tile and measured 0.0010013361 seconds; that evidence does not establish correctness or performance for this variant. The controller should validate all cases and official sizes before retaining it.
transformations: Use one thread for each output particle, retaining the destination particle and force accumulators locally.
Cooperatively stage each source tile of blockDim.x particles in dynamic shared memory; synchronize before consumption and before the tile is overwritten.
Process valid sources in ascending index order, skip self-interaction, guard source and output tails, and ensure inactive output lanes still participate in barriers.
Set block and items_per_block to 512 and dynamic shared memory to 512 * sizeof(Particle), or 14336 bytes.
